topic.title: Inbox
topic.shortdesc: What is waiting for you, today's spend and counts, then every task the agents have worked on, newest first.

image.alt: The Inbox on a phone: the Today card with spend and counts, then a list of tasks.

body.p: Each row is one task: its business, status, the first line of what came in, how it came out (the first lines of the answer, or why it failed), the role that has it, the kind of work and how long ago. Choose a row to open the task.
Task statuses are queued, running, awaiting approval, deferred (held by a daily budget), done and failed.
Nothing yet? Ask for something in Chat.
The first card gathers what needs you, whichever business it is from:

ul.li: the actions to approve (the first three; choose one to decide it, or see all);
anything you asked for in the last two days that didn't finish, with the reason (open it to retry or reply);
what you have been told but not read (the first three; see all opens Notifications).

body.p: It is hidden while the list is filtered.

The Today card shows what has been spent today against the budget, how many tasks are done or failed, how many actions ran by themselves, and how many are to approve (choose it to go to Approvals). Below that is one line per business.
When tasks were deferred by a budget, the card says so: they run after midnight, or choose retry one now to list them and run one.

Filter by vertical shows only one vertical's tasks (the link keeps the choice, so you can bookmark it), and Filter by status only tasks with one status; the two combine. Choosing a role on the Org page opens the Inbox on that role's tasks; the subtitle says Showing …, and show all clears it.
